_doc: Schema contract v3. Adds strategic context, pre-filtered ad formats, and focused funnel support.

aiRequest._note: The app builds this object from formData + deterministic results + strategic context.

client.name: string
client.regionPack: string — NA | EUI | LATAM | APAC | Global

campaign.budget: number (USD) — actual or estimated from market benchmarks
campaign.budgetProvided: boolean — true if user entered a budget, false if system estimated it

adFormats: string — ONLY these formats should be recommended (pre-filtered by spend thresholds)

phase1_research.purpose: Gather real-time info about the client/brand
phase1_research.output: Free text summary of brand, products, audience, competitors, recent activity

phase2_generate.input: Client research + campaign brief + strategic context

aiResponse._note: Each value is a markdown-formatted string. The app renders it as HTML.
aiResponse.pitch: string — Full sales pitch narrative. When budget not provided, includes strategic budget recommendation.
aiResponse.funnel: string — Objective-aligned strategy (focused or full-funnel based on deterministic.funnelStrategy)
aiResponse.mediaPlan: string — Ad format recommendations using ONLY deterministic.adFormats, plus campaign phasing
aiResponse.bestPractices: string — Tailored tips, vertical advice, budget efficiency guidance, mistakes to avoid
aiResponse.creative: string — Creative strategy, content pillars, format recommendations
aiResponse.nextSteps: string — Numbered action items; includes budget confirmation step when budget not provided

tabOwnership.pitch: AI — full narrative, grounded in client research + strategic context
tabOwnership.funnel: AI — objective-aligned strategy with deterministic budget splits referenced
tabOwnership.budgetAdvisory: APP — deterministic (market benchmarks, CPM ranges, recommended ranges)
tabOwnership.mediaPlan: AI — format rationale using deterministic pre-filtered formats
tabOwnership.creative: AI — creative strategy and content pillars
